key_insight: A risk matrix-based PPE compliance observation instrument can meaningfully improve safety compliance during SMAW welding practice.
engineering_relevance: This study provides a practical, validated OHS monitoring tool that can help welding instructors reduce safety violations in workshop training.
method: Developed the instrument using the ADDIE R&D model: Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation.
Used PPE checklists, work-condition observation sheets, and a risk matrix with 37 grade-X mechanical engineering students.
Validated the instrument with three experts before field implementation in SMAW practice.
evidence_signal: Expert validation was very strong (average 4.65/5, CVR = 1.00), and implementation reduced PPE violations from 81 to 37 while improving compliance from 1.857 to 3.914; Wilcoxon p < 0.001 and N-Gain = 0.6127.
watch_item: Results come from one vocational school cohort, so broader adoption should confirm reliability and effectiveness across different workshops, instructors, and student groups.
paper_title: Development of apd compliance observation instrument based on risk matrix for smk smaw welding practices
